corpus.title: Master Services Agreement (MSA_2026)
corpus.description: Extract obligations, payment deadlines, liability limits, and exceptions from MSA_2026. Output format: { 'payment_terms_days': int, 'liability_cap': str, 'exceptions_noted': list, 'citations': list }. Invariants: Liability cap in Section 4.2 has explicit exceptions in Section 4.3 (gross negligence and confidentiality breach).

DOC_MSA.SEC_1: Section 1: Parties. Alpha Corp ('Client') and Beta LLC ('Provider').
DOC_MSA.SEC_2: Section 2: Payment. Client shall pay all invoices within 30 days of receipt [REF_P30].
DOC_MSA.SEC_3: Section 3: Deliverables. Provider shall deliver monthly audit reports by the 5th business day.
DOC_MSA.SEC_4_1: Section 4.1: Standard Warranty. Services shall be performed in professional manner.
DOC_MSA.SEC_4_2: Section 4.2: Limitation of Liability. Total liability shall not exceed fees paid in past 12 months ($100,000) [REF_L100].
DOC_MSA.SEC_4_3: Section 4.3: Exceptions. The limitation in Section 4.2 shall NOT apply to breaches of confidentiality or gross negligence [REF_EXC].
